summary: Add customer_note column, backfill from note, deploy new app, retire old app, and drop the obsolete note column so only customer_note remains.
write_consistency: During the expand phase both note and customer_note columns coexist; old app writes to note, new app writes to customer_note. Backfill copies note values into customer_note for all rows. After deploy_new the new app is the sole writer/reader of customer_note, while the old app still operates on note. retire_old removes the old app and then drops the note column, leaving only customer_note.

stages.description: Add new column customer_note to account_user table, nullable text, alongside existing note column.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN customer_note TEXT NULL;

stages.description: Copy existing note values into customer_note for all rows so the new app can read the most recent value.
Synchronise note column with customer_note to ensure consistency before old app removal.
Deploy the new-staged app version; from this point the new app handles all reads/writes using customer_note column, while the old app continues to operate on note column concurrently.
Retire the old app version; after it is taken off traffic, drop the obsolete note column, leaving only customer_note in the schema.
